note: Full-body cut-outs of photographs the owner supplied through `scripts/photo-runner.py drop <folder> --kind fullbody`, each with the owner's dated attestation. Files: assets/img/fullbody-cutouts/<slug>.webp. ok=false means the cut-out was not kept and the page uses the sport's head-and-shoulders cut-out or photo instead. The champions carousel on the Analysis pages prefers these.
